lines.en: Nina, I have two project ideas, and each of them has a problem. Both of us need to decide before Friday.
lines.pt: Nina, tenho duas ideias de projeto, e cada uma delas tem um problema. Nós duas precisamos decidir até sexta.

lines.en: Neither of my ideas is perfect. Every student in our group has a different opinion, so each of us must compromise.
lines.pt: Nenhuma das minhas ideias é perfeita. Cada aluno do nosso grupo tem uma opinião diferente, então cada uma de nós precisa ceder.

lines.en: Either of the two topics could work, but both of them need more research than we have time for.
lines.pt: Qualquer um dos dois temas poderia funcionar, mas ambos precisam de mais pesquisa do que temos tempo.

lines.en: Then let us choose the one that each of us can explain clearly. Every presentation needs a simple message.
lines.pt: Então vamos escolher o que cada uma de nós consegue explicar com clareza. Toda apresentação precisa de uma mensagem simples.

lines.en: The teacher said that neither of the previous groups had finished on time, and both of them lost marks.
lines.pt: O professor disse que nenhum dos grupos anteriores terminou a tempo, e ambos perderam pontos.

lines.en: That is why I prefer the shorter topic. Each of the interviews we need could be done in one afternoon.
lines.pt: Por isso prefiro o tema mais curto. Cada uma das entrevistas de que precisamos poderia ser feita numa tarde.

lines.en: Both of the libraries in town are open on Saturday, so either of them is fine for research.
lines.pt: As duas bibliotecas da cidade abrem no sábado, então qualquer uma delas serve para pesquisar.

lines.en: I will ask every member of the group whether each of them can come at ten.
lines.pt: Vou perguntar a cada membro do grupo se cada um pode vir às dez.

lines.en: If neither of the others replies, we will start without them. Each of us has enough material for a section.
lines.pt: Se nenhum dos outros responder, começamos sem eles. Cada uma de nós tem material suficiente para uma seção.

lines.en: I only worry that both of us might forget to check the final version before we submit it.
lines.pt: Só me preocupo que nós duas possamos esquecer de conferir a versão final antes de entregar.

lines.en: Then each of us will read the whole text once more, and every mistake will be marked in red.
lines.pt: Então cada uma de nós lerá o texto inteiro mais uma vez, e cada erro será marcado em vermelho.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Each of us takes a singular verb in formal English.
items.why: Yes: each of us has a task.

items.s: We say “neither of them are ready” as the safest form.
items.why: The safest form is neither of them is ready.

items.s: Both of us means the two people together.

answers: Each of us takes a singular verb in formal English. → Verdadeiro (Yes: each of us has a task.)
We say “neither of them are ready” as the safest form. → Falso (The safest form is neither of them is ready.)
Both of us means the two people together. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A group project · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet morning in Houston. Dana arrives early at the classroom. Books and notes cover her desk. The teacher has given the group a big project. Nina comes in with two cups of coffee. They sit down to make a plan.

“Nina, I have two project ideas, and each of them has a problem. Both of us need to decide before Friday.” says Dana. “Neither of my ideas is perfect. Every student in our group has a different opinion, so each of us must compromise.” says Nina. “Either of the two topics could work, but both of them need more research than we have time for.” says Dana.
